title: Affected-tests-first pays on first attempts when the first-attempt failure rate exceeds ~36%
summary: If orchestrator telemetry shows that more than ~36% of first-attempt validations fail (tests_completed events with passed=false on attempt 1), switching affected_tests_first from 'retries' to 'always' lowers total validation wall time. Measure from run telemetry once at least 30 real validations exist; do not change the default before then.
